name: agent-chat
description: Cross-host agent chat over a private Matrix homeserver: Claude sends into the project's invite-only room with agent-chat send, and a hook-run wait wakes an idle interactive Claude session when a message addressed to its account arrives. Codex sends in two steps through a prepared message file, and agent-chat watch-codex queues mail for the Codex account to a Codex thread. Each message is labelled with its sender's authority. Ships the command, the hooks, a Claude skill, a Codex skill and example Codex rules.
